name: Badger Summer Scholars (Badger Precollege)
what_you_do: Take a college-level course of your choice for two weeks on the UW-Madison campus. Residential students live in a residence hall.
who_can_apply: Students finishing grades 9 to 12. Admission usually looks at a 3.0 unweighted GPA or similar, coursework, interest in the course and essays. No age range is stated. The page lists tuition for domestic and international students and says students connect with peers from across the country.
pay_detail: 2027: domestic residential $4,500; commuter $2,650; international $4,800; plus a $100 application fee (fee waivers can be requested). Scholarships exist (see notes).
deadline_text: 2027 cycle: applications open Jan 12, 2027 and close May 1, 2027. Scholarship forms should arrive by Apr 1.
how_to_apply: Online application with two essays (video or written) and an unofficial transcript. Decisions come on the 2nd and 4th Monday of each month.
notes: Full scholarship for Wisconsin residents who get free or reduced lunch; partial scholarship (up to 50%) with income paperwork; none for international students. Funds are limited and first come, first served. Contact info@precollege.wisc.edu or 608-890-3260.
